title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Gameplay Deep Dive
summary: Feel more control across every game mode in EA SPORTS FC™ 27 through manual defending, smarter attacking movement, and more.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: Welcome to the EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Gameplay Deep Dive. My name is Gilliard Lopes, Principal Gameplay Designer for EA SPORTS FC™.

sections.title: AI Defending (Auto-Tackles)
sections.summary: The following changes to AI Defending only apply to Competitive gameplay. For more information about changes to Authentic Gameplay, stay tuned for our Career Mode Deep Dive coming soon.

sections.title: Manual Defending Improvements
sections.summary: Reducing the impact of AI defending is only one part of the defensive changes coming in FC 27. Improving the effectiveness of manual defending is the other crucial piece we’re focusing on in order to create more rewarding defensive experiences.

sections.title: Teammate Contain
sections.summary: Teammate Contain has also been adjusted to match our new approach to defending. When performing Teammate Contain, AI teammates will mark the ball carrier from a slightly longer distance than before, requiring the user to switch to them and manually defend if…

sections.title: Corner Kick Improvements
sections.summary: Corners in FC 27 are designed to give you more control over the moments before the ball arrives in the box. Previously, players had fewer ways to influence direct deliveries, which meant many opted to take corners short instead.

sections.title: Free Movement and Positioning
sections.summary: In FC 27, players contesting for corner kicks in the box will no longer automatically move into the best position to connect with the ball. It’s up to you to time the run, attack the space, and make first contact manually.

sections.title: Shielding and Avoidance
sections.summary: During the window before a ball is delivered, attackers can manually trigger a new mechanic called Avoidance. This allows any attacker or defender you control to become more evasive, moving through crowded areas without getting blocked by opposing players.

sections.title: Crossing Rework
sections.summary: We’re also adding more crossing control in FC 27. Previously, crosses had more predictable trajectories and similar finishing animations because they were heavily assisted.

sections.title: Finishing Variety and Headers
sections.summary: These updates enable more variety when heading and finishing from both corner kicks and crosses. We want the battle for ball contact to become more skill-based and lead to more authentic outcomes.

sections.title: Attacking Spatial Awareness
sections.summary: Our updated Attacking Spatial Awareness makes AI attackers more aware of the space around them and how they move into it. Previously, some attacking movements could feel too predictable, with players not always reacting quickly to developing attacks or…

sections.title: Triggered Curved Runs & Pass & Follow Runs
sections.summary: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 introduces new manually triggered run options designed to give you more control over off-ball movement. While a regular triggered run sends the player forward in a direct path, the new Triggered Curved Runs allow them to curve their movement…

sections.title: Limited Distance for Manually Triggered Runs
sections.summary: Another important change is that manually triggered runs will no longer continue indefinitely. Previously you could trigger a run while close to a player, move the ball a long distance away, and rely on that player to continue their run indefinitely.

sections.title: Improved Creative Runs
sections.summary: In FC 27, we are also improving attacking runs that happen without a manual trigger, taking into account available space, defensive positioning, and the offside line. For example, a winger may run parallel to the defensive line while waiting for a pass.

sections.title: Through Passes Update
sections.summary: In FC 27, ground and lobbed through passes no longer heavily assist you by steering toward open lanes away from your aim. Passes now strictly follow your directional input, rewarding deliberate aim on attack and giving manual defenders a fair chance to read…

sections.title: Dinked Passes Update
sections.summary: In FC 27, we have moved both ground and through Dinked Passes to a fully manual system. Success now relies heavily on your individual precision with aiming and power, raising the skill ceiling for these specific pass types.

sections.title: Off-Balance Dribbling
sections.summary: In FC 27, the world’s best dribblers can now ride challenges and maintain control under pressure through off-balance dribbling. Driven by Balance, Agility and Dribbling Attributes, this allows certain players to continue dribbling even when they are knocked…
